Hi Alex / Sam —

Short answers + what we can provide for your firewall/team review:

1) PrivateLink vs VPC peering
- We support both. PrivateLink (AWS VPC Endpoint Service) is our recommended path for minimal routing changes and to avoid cross-account peering policies.

2) Static IPs / allowlist
- For PrivateLink, we front the service with an AWS NLB per-AZ; we can allocate Elastic IPs for those NLBs in the region which are stable for the lifetime of the Endpoint Service. We will provide the list of EIPs (typically 2-4 per region depending on AZ coverage) that you can allow on your perimeter firewall.
- If you choose peering, you can allow the Acme VPC CIDR to talk directly and no per-EIP allowlist is required.

3) Ports/protocols
- Primary traffic: HTTPS / TCP 443 to the Redwood API hostnames (we terminate TLS).
- Optional: outbound TCP 443 for metrics/log shipping to our secure telemetry endpoints (we can proxy telemetry over the same HTTPS channel if you prefer to avoid extra openings).

4) Transit Gateway
- We are compatible with TGW. If you route through TGW, ensure the TGW attachments include the subnets that will host the interface endpoints and allow the NLB EIPs if using PrivateLink.

5) CIDR / MTU guidance
- No special MTU required (1500 recommended).
- If peering, avoid overlapping CIDRs. Our recommended small-range example for egress/outbound NAT: 54.240.128.0/23 (we will provide actual ranges per deployment).

6) DNS and routing changes needed (PrivateLink)
- We will provide a private hosted zone and DNS records to point your callers to the private endpoint DNS name (or you can create an Alias to the interface endpoint).
- You will need to attach appropriate subnets (private subnets) for the interface endpoints and allow outbound HTTPS from the calling subnets.

Attachments in this thread include: network_diagram_v2.pdf and redwood-private-setup-checklist.xlsx (checklist includes a stub CloudFormation peering request and PrivateLink setup doc).

If helpful, we can provide a short template email and firewall rules file for your security team. Happy to jump on a 30-min network sync with your infra folks — please propose a few slots.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
